text: Long catch up with Chantal. She's got a second interview at the housing association on Thursday and is properly nervous about the presentation part. Her sister Nora is helping her prep this weekend. Remind me to text Chantal good luck Wednesday night.

Coffee with Leon and Hamza. Leon finally handed his notice in, last day is 14 November. Hamza's still applying for grad schemes, has had four rejections and sounds pretty fed up. I should send him that recruiter's details.
Errands for Saturday: drop the parcel back at the post office, pick up the dry cleaning, get the car's MOT booked before 3rd of December.
Zofia rang. Her mum's having her knee done on 22/10 and she's going up to Leeds for the week to look after her. Her boss has been fine about it. Need to check in with her when she's back.

Spoke to Magda after the school run. Her husband Victor got the job at the engineering firm, starts Monday. She was so relieved, they'd been worried about money since summer. Don't forget to send them a card.
Deepa had her final interview at the bank yesterday. Thinks it went ok but they said two weeks to hear. Ask her about it next Friday.
Eva and her partner are moving to Bristol in a fortnight. She's started applying for jobs down there, mostly marketing roles. Their dog Biscuit hates the car so the drive will be fun.
Dentist moved to next Tuesday 9.15. Must remember to cancel the gym class.
Aoife told me the hen do in Galway is off, her friend called the whole wedding off last month. She's gutted about the deposit. Instead she's going to Lisbon with Caitlin on 7th of March.
Ioana's son Andrei has his first proper job interview tomorrow, at the Co-op. Ioana says he's terrified and barely slept. Remind me to ask her how he got on.
Zeynep - loves bouldering, goes three times a week, vegan. Works in HR at the council. Good person to ask about application tips.

Had a long natter with Eilidh and her brother Fergus at the market. Fergus is retiring at Christmas after thirty years on the railways and they're planning a do for him on 20 December. Eilidh wants to keep it small. She mentioned he's been eyeing up a good pair of walking boots, could chip in for those.
Need to renew my passport before the end of the month. Also book the boiler service, ideally for a Friday.

Dmitri and Femi came round for dinner. Dmitri's waiting on results from the civil service assessment centre, should hear this week. Femi has just started a part time masters in data science and is finding it a lot alongside work. Femi's birthday is 3 Feb.
Neha's dad is in hospital again, chest infection. She's going up after work every day. I need to ring her tomorrow and see if she needs anything.
Quick one: Wei got the internship!! Starts 6/01. Send him congrats.
Ifeoma mentioned her daughter is applying to medical school, interviews in January. She's doing mock interviews with her uncle who's a GP. Ifeoma is more nervous than the daughter by the sound of it.

Called Hannah. She didn't get the head of department role, they gave it to someone external. She's taking it pretty hard and thinking about moving schools. Her husband Tom is being supportive. I should take her out for lunch next week.
Kate's cat Pickle has to go in for surgery on Friday, some lump on his side. She's anxious about it. Text her Friday evening.
Oliver says his brother Jamie passed his driving test this morning, third time lucky. Oliver's buying him a keyring as a joke.
Things for this week: shoes to the cobbler, return library books by 18th, buy stamps, sort the recycling bins out with the council.

Bridget popped over. Her granddaughter's christening is on the 2nd of November and she's doing the buffet. She asked if I could lend her the big urn. Her husband Des is still recovering from his hip op so she's doing most of it herself.
Santiago had his interview at Google last Tuesday, the onsite one, five rounds. Said the system design round was rough but the rest felt good. Ask him if he's heard anything.

Lunch with Farid and Imani. Farid's starting at the hospital as a staff nurse on Monday, finally out of agency work. Imani's got her PhD viva on 12 December and keeps saying she's fine but clearly isn't. Their little one starts nursery in January as well. Busy few months for them.
Wiremu's moving back to Auckland next spring, his mum isn't well and he wants to be closer. He's applying for teaching jobs over there. Sad but makes sense.
Fang said her interview got cancelled, the company froze hiring. She's applying elsewhere now.

Hassan and his wife Leila are expecting their second, due in April. He also mentioned he's up for promotion to senior manager, review is on the 28th. Remind me to get something small for the baby nearer the time.
Jen - allergic to nuts, doesn't drink, big into Formula 1. Her partner is called Sophie.
Bins out tonight. Tomorrow: bank at 10, then pick up the prescription.
Chantal called back after her interview. They offered her the job on the spot! She starts on 1st of December. Her mum's already planning a celebration dinner on Sunday.
Leon's sister Marta is getting married on 14 June in Kraków. Leon's best man and very stressed about the speech. I'm going to the wedding too so need to sort flights.
Aoife's grandad passed away on Monday. Funeral is next Thursday in Cork. She's flying out Wednesday. Don't forget to send flowers.
Spoke to Deepa again. She got the bank job! Starts 5 January. Her husband Raj is taking her out to celebrate this weekend.
I'm doing the Christmas shopping on the 6th, the big Tesco run on the 22nd, and wrapping on Christmas Eve. Note to self: order the turkey by 1st of December.

Zofia's back from Leeds. Her mum's recovery is going slowly and Zofia's exhausted, juggling that with her new job applications. She has a phone interview with a charity on Monday. I should send her a care package.
Victor's first week at the firm went well apparently, he loves the team. Magda says he's already been put on a big project. Their son Max turns 7 on Saturday, he wants anything dinosaur.
Caitlin and Aoife are flying out to Lisbon early March. Caitlin's never been and Aoife lived there for a year after uni.
Hamza texted, he got an interview for the Deloitte grad scheme! It's on 19/11. He's nervous because it's a group exercise. Remind me to message him the morning of.
Eva's dog Biscuit has gone missing in the new place, ran off on Tuesday. She's devastated and putting posters up everywhere. Check in with her tomorrow.
Ioana says Andrei got the Co-op job, starts weekends from next week. She's so proud. Also her husband Mihai is turning 50 on 3rd of January, they're having a party at the Polish club.
Eilidh's do for Fergus has been moved to the 21st because the venue double booked. I've said I'll bring a cake.
Need to: ring the landlord about the leak, email HR about my leave dates, book a haircut for next Saturday.
Femi is really struggling with the masters, thinking of deferring. Dmitri says she's been in tears a couple of times. Need to call her this weekend.
Dmitri heard back, he passed the assessment centre and starts the Fast Stream in September! Congratulate him next time I see him.
Neha's dad is home from hospital. Neha says he's tired but ok. Her brother Arjun is staying with them for a fortnight to help out.

Bumped into Wei and his girlfriend Lin at the station. Wei's internship starts in January and Lin has an interview at a law firm on Friday. She was pretty calm about it. They're off to Shanghai for New Year.
Hannah emailed, she's had an interview at a school in Harrogate for a head of English job, next Wednesday. She seems excited about it. Ask her on Thursday how it went.
Kate said Pickle's surgery went fine and the lump was benign. She's very relieved.
Oliver's starting a new job at the hospice on 3/11 as a fundraiser. His old boss tried to keep him but he's ready for a change. He gets very nervous about first days.
Bridget - grandma of 5, loves gardening and crosswords. Mentioned she'd love a new pair of secateurs.
Me: start looking for new jobs properly. Update CV this weekend and apply to at least three by Friday.
Santiago heard back, he didn't get the Google role. He's disappointed but has another interview with Spotify on 10th of November. I should text him good luck the day before.

Farid's first week at the hospital done. Imani's viva has been brought forward to 28/11 which has thrown her a bit. Their son Ali loved his nursery settling-in day. Remember to text Imani before the viva.
Hassan's review went well, he got the promotion. Leila said they're celebrating with a meal on Friday. Send congrats.

Caught up with Jen and her partner Sophie. They're celebrating five years together on 14 February and thinking of a weekend in Paris. Jen's also interviewing for a new job at a tech startup next Tuesday. She's anxious, it's her first interview in years.
Wiremu's leaving do is on 15 March at the Red Lion. He's sold his flat already. Need to get him a leaving card and something kiwi-ish.
Car service Thursday. Drop it at 8, collect after 5. Ask about the tyres.
Imani's viva went really well, minor corrections only! Farid sounded so proud on the phone. Their family are coming over from Nairobi for the graduation in the summer.
Magda's brother Piotr has been made redundant after twelve years. He's job hunting and she's worried about him. Remind me to ask her if he wants me to look over his CV.
Zeynep ran a CV workshop at work today which was really useful. She said she's applying for a senior HR role herself, interview on 2nd of December. Should ask her how it goes.
